- .claude/commands/claude-issue-pickup.md:lines 33-41 (start section and cleanup calls paragraph) | severity=critical | confidence=5

  PROBLEM: The Rules bullet lacks the asserted restart deferral rule.
  WHY: The test's assertion for `"A restart that leaves the older pickup's session unarchived reads nothing until its own first hourly wake"` fails.

The PR description says this fix is applied in PR #5097 (sixth twin sync) and the test `test_pickup_skips_a_denied_cleanup_call` asserts it.
  Expected change site: .claude/commands/claude-issue-pickup.md — the `start` paragraph (line 38), the "Cleanup calls" paragraph (line 41), and the "One pickup, never deeper." Rules bullet (line 84)
  Evidence of absence: Line 38 says "Then continue with step 2 now, so the queue is drained immediately" with no conditional deferral. Line 41 says "For that one wake both pickups can read the queue." Line 84 has no deferral text. The test fails because these strings are absent and the pre-AD-10 text remains. The progress log acknowledges the test failure and says the fix is pending a sixth twin-sync. The last commit `10d3e6d` added the test and progress log but did not update the pickup file.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
